Are you looking for a job as Production employee and working with plants? 
As a production worker, you will work with chrysanthemum cuttings in a greenhouse environment. Your main task is to prepare the plant cuttings that arrive from Tanzania and make sure they are ready for further processing. You will work together with machine operators and help place the cuttings into soil trays using modern machines. 
You will also check the quality of the planted cuttings and make small manual corrections when needed. If you notice technical problems with the machines, you will report them to the technical department so they can be solved quickly. No experience is needed because full training is provided. 
The work is not physically heavy, but it is mostly repetitive, so you will often do similar tasks during the day. This job is suitable for people who prefer structured and steady work. The company works with two shifts. The morning shift is from 06:00 to 15:00, and the evening shift is from 15:00 to 23:00/24:00. 
Each shift includes a 1-hour break. For the evening shift, work done between 20:00 and 24:00 is paid with a 50% extra allowance. Employees work in a mixed rotation schedule, which means you may work both morning and evening shifts. 
 Job Requirements 
 - You have a good sense of responsibility and are focused on quality. - You are able to communicate English and if you speak Polish is a plus. - You are able to work physically and the repetitive work does not bother you. - You want to work in a stable and growing environment. 
 Employment conditions 
 - Employment contract with Charlie works - Health Insurance - Pension scheme - Travel allowance - Opportunities for self-development through relevant training

Do you know those delicious American Cookies at McDonalds and KFC? Have you always wanted to know the secret behind their recipe? Nice! Because now you can! If you start working as a production employee! Do you want to work with a salary of €33,85 per hour (shift allowance included)? Great! It's possible at Europastry in Steenbergen!

What we offer
- A nice salary of €16,12 gross per hour
- Higher hourly wage after 26 weeks - €16,99!
- Shift allowances between 38% and 110%!
- Travel expenses from 0,25 cent per kilometer
- Possibility to get a fixed contract
- Possibility to grow within the company

Who you are
To keep the factory running, it is important that you meet the following requirements as a production worker:

- You speak Dutch or English;
- You have your own transport to get to Steenbergen;
- You are full time available;
- You are available for 5 shifts.

What will you do
As a production employee at Europastry you work at the beginning of the cookie line. You are responsible for collecting and preparing all resources. Think of flour, butter and sugar! Then you weigh everything. And get everything ready for the batter. The batter for the cookies and muffins is made in large kettles. You also help with packing and cleaning work. The work is physically challenging. For example, you are busy lifting bags of ingredients and large baking trays on a daily basis. So, overall a lot of things to do!

You can work in 3 or 5 shifts:

- 🕕 06:00 - 14:00 uur
- 🕑14:00 - 22:00 uur
- 🌙 22:00 - 06:00 uur.

Where will you work
Now you are of course curious where you will be working? The tastiest company in Steenbergen of course! Everyone here knows each other. You will work here as a production employee at the cookie factory Europastry. Here they make cookies and muffins for large companies such as McDonalds, KFC and Lidl. Delicious! Wonderful to work with, isn't it?!  #baanrader
